scoring_justification: Bandwidth and angular range with R>0.99 are recomputed from raw reflectivity CSVs. No self-reported numbers are trusted; the checker reads the agent's raw spectrum and angle-scan data and computes the metrics itself.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden thresholds for fractional bandwidth (0.30) and angular range (40°) used in threshold_or_better scoring of the optimized thick-grating structure.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and Section 3: 'The high-reflectivity (R > 0.99) bandwidth (Δf/f̄) is greater than 30%' and 'the angle tolerance is up to 40°'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's stated headline performance numbers for the optimized structure (h1=0.685Λ, h2=0.45Λ, η=0.5, εr=11.9).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported thresholds; no synthetic or hand-crafted values are used.

outputs.description: Reflectivity contour map for the thin-grating structure. Verified for existence, expected columns, and data within reasonable ranges.
Reflectivity spectrum for the optimized structure. The checker recomputes the fractional bandwidth where reflectivity > 0.99 and compares to the hidden threshold using threshold_or_better.
Angle-dependent reflectivity for the optimized structure. The checker recomputes the angular range where reflectivity > 0.99 and compares to the hidden threshold using threshold_or_better.

output_contract.notes: The solver may be S4 or any equivalent RCWA implementation. All structure parameters are fully normalized; any absolute period Λ may be chosen. The checker performs a structural audit on the contour map and recomputes bandwidth/angular range from the other two CSVs. No pixel-level comparison with the paper's figures is required.

steps.description: Structural audit of the thin-grating contour map: file exists, has required columns, data in plausible ranges, and sufficient data points.
Recompute fractional bandwidth Δf/f̄ where reflectivity > 0.99 from the raw spectrum. Score against paper threshold 0.30 using threshold_or_better.
Recompute the contiguous angular range (degrees) where reflectivity > 0.99 from the raw angle scan. Score against paper threshold 40° using threshold_or_better.
